decisions.reason: ACE3 builds directly on the firm's core ALCMS knowledge, so its in-house R&D can keep interpreting field results and improving it, which makes it a durable part of the established airfield offer.
The airport systems training program uses the firm's deep operational and integration know-how and returns customer learning to the firm, so it complements the system business at low cost.
The airfield ground lighting course is closely tied to the firm's core lighting expertise and supports installed-base service, so keeping it fits the firm's existing knowledge.

The collaboration software tool fits the strategic direction toward data-driven collaborative decision-making, and the firm's integration and R&D capabilities let it learn from deployments, though software carries more uncertainty than the firm's hardware core.

The multilateration surveillance system is a flagship of the integrated airport operations strategy and is supported by in-house R&D, although the earlier withdrawal of the surveillance display shows the surveillance knowledge base is less mature and adds some risk.
